about: IMAGERY lane plan for the LANTERN KEEP redesign. Generated imagery is mood only: never captioned or described as CastleLeaf's store, staff, customers or products. Every id below is read by gimg('<id>') from assets/generated/<id>.jpg (backdrops) or .png (cut-outs, alpha). aspect = the delivered file's ratio; input.aspect_ratio = what the model was asked for (FLUX ultra has no 4:5, so the category series is generated at 3:4 and cropped to 4:5). calmArea = where text can sit.

defaults.style: Fine art photograph, medium format, true-to-life materials and textures, crisp focus on the subject, fine natural film grain. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no labels, no stickers, no logos, no brand names, no signage, no symbols of any script anywhere in the image. No faces.

The plinth stands right of centre, at about 62 percent across the frame, its top at about 62 percent of the frame height, its base fading into shadow. Everything else falls into deep warm charcoal-brown darkness, never pure black. The whole left half of the frame is calm, empty, softly graded dark wall with nothing in it; the far right edge also falls off into shadow. Painterly chiaroscuro like an old master painting, but photographic and razor sharp on the flower and the glass. No people, no hands.
